items.text: Garrett Wilson ruled OUT with concussion for Week 9 vs KC per final reports and ETR/Levitan summary. Expect Jets 2-WR sets featuring AD Mitchell and Omar Cooper.
items.why: Concussion symptoms after Week 8 hit; no practice all week.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; volume shifts to secondary Jets WRs.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining Jets pass-catchers in 2-WR sets.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) will return Sunday; practiced full Friday after DNP-LP-FP progression and bye rest. Not on final injury report.
items.why: Hamstring recovery complete enough for full participation post-bye.
items.implication: Immediate RB1 restart; 49ers offense leans heavily on CMC + Kittle with other WRs thinned.
items.opportunity: Full snap/carry/route share expected vs Raiders.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) are OUT. Giants WR Malik Nabers (knee) good to go; RB Cam Skattebo (hamstring) doubtful.
items.why: Hamstring/ankle for Eagles WRs; Nabers cleared knee; Skattebo hamstring limits.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth tested; Nabers full go; Giants RB to Singletary + practice squad.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for remaining PHI/NYG pass-catchers; Giants RB committee shift.

items.text: Patriots officially ruled out WR AJ Brown (knee/ankle) and RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness).
items.why: Knee primary for Brown (lingering concerns); Henderson unusual medical/illness requiring hospitalization.
items.implication: Sit both; NE pass game thinned further.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes open for remaining NE WRs/TEs (Hunter Henry Q).

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) listed IN/ACTIVE after full participation; returns from 5-game absence in likely timeshare with Braelon Allen (power early downs, Hall receiving).
items.why: Full practice Friday; self-reported ready after quad strain since Week 3.
items.implication: Flex option; complementary role vs Chiefs run D.
items.opportunity: Passing-down and change-of-pace work; Allen retains early-down share.

items.text: QUESTIONABLE include Amon-Ra St. Brown, George Pickens, Jake Ferguson, Emeka Egbuka, Hunter Henry, Mack Hollins. Levitan notes sneaky importance of Henry/Hollins status with Brown/Henderson out; projects some in.
items.implication: Monitor finals; have backups ready. Pickens benefit spot per Silva matchups.
items.opportunity: If active, full roles; else beneficiaries on respective teams.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin) per ETR final injury summary alongside other Texans notes.
items.implication: Houston RB volume to remaining backs.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for HOU RB committee without Montgomery.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed IN/ACTIVE (hamstring/back); shocked not on final report earlier but cleared and playing.
items.why: Cleared final report despite prior hamstring/back.
items.implication: Start as RB1; monitor for limited efficiency.

items.text: WR Mike Evans will miss second straight game (Achilles tendinitis); Nick Bosa (calf) and CMC return for 49ers.
items.implication: 49ers WR room limited to Watkins/Cowing/Cooks; heavy CMC/Kittle reliance.
items.opportunity: More volume to remaining 49ers skill players.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Jonathan Taylor (RB9) vs DAL; expects another big multi-TD potential week.
items.why: Strong matchup and recent multi-TD form; start with confidence.

items.text: Berry LOVES Drake London (WR6) vs CIN; strong matchup for production.
Berry LOVES George Pickens (WR16) in Cowboys-Colts spot; advantageous matchup as #SqueakyWheel.
items.why: Soft matchup and role; monitor Q status.
items.conflict: Q tag creates uncertainty vs pure love.

items.text: Berry HATES Alvin Kamara this week vs CLE due to poor Saints run game efficiency.
items.why: Atrocious NO run game YPC and scheme issues.

items.text: ETR ROS Top-150 updated Nov 4 factored Lamar/Huntley losses (Henry/Flowers downgraded significantly), other role/injury changes; use for trades not waivers.
items.why: Ravens QB chaos post-Lamar IR and Huntley season-ending; Brissett arrival context.
items.implication: Lower trade value for BAL skill; adjust ROS rankings.
